CustomField.description: Boolean formula that returns TRUE when GiftsThisYearAmount meets or exceeds the Entry.Annual_Min_Amount__c value in FQS_Donor_Grouping custom metadata. Note: GiftsThisYearAmount is a calendar-year rollup from NPC. Thresholds are configured via Setup → Custom Metadata Types → FQS Donor Grouping or the FQS Setup screen flow. Changing threshold values in Setup or via the FQS Setup flow recalculates this field across all Donor Gift Summary records retroactively — no redeployment or batch job required. Reports and dashboards using this field will reflect the new values immediately.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated. The field is checked when this donor's current-year giving qualifies for the Entry donor grouping. Your administrator controls the threshold amount.
CustomField.label: Is Entry Annual Donor
